exposure: Short-stay admission to a Level 5 neonatal unit (≤72 hours) vs. no admission
cohort: 12,540 mothers and their infants born at ≥36 weeks gestation and weighing ≥2.2 kg who were eligible for discharge from the hospital at ≤72 hours
finding: Short-stay admission to a neonatal unit was associated with a lower likelihood of full breastfeeding at hospital discharge compared to no admission.
